label: Nextcloud
description: Connect a Nextcloud instance so agents can manage files, shares, calendars, and contacts.

apps.label: Files
apps.description: Browse, search, upload, share, and restore files in a connected Nextcloud account.

apps.label: Calendar
apps.description: List calendars and create, update, or delete events in Nextcloud Calendar.

apps.label: Contacts
apps.description: List address books and create, update, or delete Nextcloud contacts.

connectPrompt: Add your Nextcloud URL once, then sign in on the Nextcloud login page.

tools.name: nextcloud_list_files
tools.description: List files and folders in a Nextcloud path. Omit path for the account root. When multiple Files accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

path.description: Folder path relative to the user root, for example Documents.

account_email.description: Optional connected Files account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_search_files
tools.description: Search Nextcloud files by name or content using unified search. When multiple Files accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Files account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_read_file
tools.description: Read a small text file from Nextcloud. Use nextcloud_download_file for binary or large files. When multiple Files accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

path.description: File path relative to the user root.

account_email.description: Optional connected Files account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_download_file
tools.description: Download a Nextcloud file to a local destination path. When multiple Files accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

destination_path.description: Absolute local file path to write.

account_email.description: Optional connected Files account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file from your workspace into Nextcloud. When multiple Files accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

file_path.description: The file to upload: a path in your workspace or an owned artifact.

path.description: Destination Nextcloud path, including file name.

account_email.description: Optional connected Files account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a Nextcloud text file with the given content. When multiple Files accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Files account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_mkdir
tools.description: Create a Nextcloud folder. When multiple Files accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Files account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a Nextcloud file or folder. When multiple Files accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

overwrite.description: Overwrite an existing destination. Defaults to false.

account_email.description: Optional connected Files account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_copy_file
tools.description: Copy a Nextcloud file or folder. When multiple Files accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

overwrite.description: Overwrite an existing destination. Defaults to false.

account_email.description: Optional connected Files account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_delete_file
tools.description: Delete a Nextcloud file or folder. Deleted items go to trash when trash is enabled. When multiple Files accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Files account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_list_shares
tools.description: List Nextcloud shares the connected account made, or those shared with it, optionally filtered by path. When multiple Files accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

path.description: Optional file or folder path to filter shares.

shared_with_me.description: List shares other people made with this account instead.

account_email.description: Optional connected Files account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_create_share
tools.description: Create a Nextcloud share. share_type 3 is a public link, 0 is a user, 1 is a group. When multiple Files accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

path.description: File or folder path to share.

share_type.description: Nextcloud share type. Defaults to 3 (public link).

share_with.description: User, group, or email for non-link shares.

password.description: Optional password for a public link.

account_email.description: Optional connected Files account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_delete_share
tools.description: Delete a Nextcloud share by share id. When multiple Files accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Files account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_list_trash
tools.description: List items in the Nextcloud trash bin. When multiple Files accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Files account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_restore_trash
tools.description: Restore a Nextcloud trash item by the path returned from nextcloud_list_trash. When multiple Files accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Files account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_ocs_request
tools.description: Make an authenticated Nextcloud OCS request under /ocs/v2.php/ for apps such as Notes or Deck. Talk messaging stays in Settings → Messaging. When multiple Files accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.

account_email.description: Optional connected Files account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_list_calendars
tools.description: List CalDAV calendars for the connected Nextcloud account. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_list_events
tools.description: List events in a Nextcloud calendar. Defaults to the next 30 days when start/end are omitted. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_get_event
tools.description: Get one Nextcloud calendar event by calendar path and event path. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

event_path.description: Event href path, for example personal/event.ics.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_create_event
tools.description: Create a Nextcloud calendar event. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_update_event
tools.description: Replace a Nextcloud calendar event. Include the full replacement fields. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_delete_event
tools.description: Delete a Nextcloud calendar event. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_list_addressbooks
tools.description: List CardDAV address books for the connected Nextcloud account. When multiple Contacts accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Contacts account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts in a Nextcloud address book. When multiple Contacts accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Contacts account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_get_contact
tools.description: Get one Nextcloud contact by address book and contact path. When multiple Contacts accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

contact_path.description: Contact href path, for example contacts/person.vcf.

account_email.description: Optional connected Contacts account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_create_contact
tools.description: Create a Nextcloud contact in an address book. When multiple Contacts accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Contacts account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_update_contact
tools.description: Replace a Nextcloud contact. Include the full replacement fields. When multiple Contacts accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Contacts account email or identifier.

tools.name: nextcloud_delete_contact
tools.description: Delete a Nextcloud contact. When multiple Contacts accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Contacts account email or identifier.
